"""S11c pre-flight: run the app's OWN Claude paths against the live API once, check every reply, save fixtures.

    cd backend && CLAUDE_MODE=live ../.venv/Scripts/python ../scripts/preflight_live.py [reader] [namer] [policy] [doctor]

What runs (no arguments = all four parts), all through the app's routes or service functions:
  reader  POST /api/businesses for 3 fresh sellers + the handwritten photo; prices, tidy-up, the shop page renders
  namer   GET /api/businesses/<id>/names for the first shop
  policy  policy_check() on the 5 cases in tests/fixtures/policy_cases.json (the verdict must match `expect`)
  doctor  a practice launch, the `a_record` fault, "Check again": the investigating Doctor must look and re-point

Money: everything is recorded in a scratch database (replay/raw/preflight_s11c.db, git-ignored) whose daily cap is
$0.25, so the cap holds across re-runs on the same day. GoDaddy, DNS and mail are the pretend world. The key is read
from .env by the app's Settings and never printed. Stops at the first failure (re-run only the parts that are left).
"""

import html
import json
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "backend"))

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient  # noqa: E402
from sqlmodel import Session  # noqa: E402

from app.agents.claude_client import FIXTURE_DIR, FallbackClaudeClient, LiveClaudeClient, spent_today_usd  # noqa: E402
from app.agents.policy import policy_check  # noqa: E402
from app.agents.reader import HARD_FIXTURES, Profile  # noqa: E402
from app.config import Settings, get_settings  # noqa: E402
from app.db import get_session, init_db, make_engine  # noqa: E402
from app.integrations import fake_integrations, get_integrations, get_practice_integrations  # noqa: E402
from app.main import create_app  # noqa: E402
from app.routers.businesses import get_claude  # noqa: E402
from app.sites.render import format_inr, render_site  # noqa: E402

CAP_USD = 0.25
ADMIN_TOKEN = "preflight-admin-token-0123456789"
ORIGIN = "http://localhost"
READERS = ["tiffin_hinglish", "candle_note", "tailor_from", "handwritten_photo"]
CASES = json.loads((HARD_FIXTURES.parent / "policy_cases.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


class Recording:
    """Passes every call to live Claude and keeps (fixture name, reply)."""

    def __init__(self, live):
        self.live_client, self.replies = live, []

    def ask_json(self, **kw):
        data = self.live_client.ask_json(**kw)
        self.replies.append((kw["fixture"], data))
        return data


def save(name: str, data: dict) -> None:
    (FIXTURE_DIR / f"{name}.json").write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


def check_shop(case: dict, profile: Profile) -> None:
    """Real prices kept, "from" prices marked, and the seller page renders with every item on it."""
    prices = sorted(p.price_inr for p in profile.products)
    want, optional = sorted(case["expected_prices"]), case.get("optional_prices", [])
    extra = list(prices)
    for p in want:
        assert p in extra, f"price {p} missing: got {prices}"
        extra.remove(p)
    assert all(p in optional for p in extra), f"unexpected prices {extra}: got {prices}"
    for p in profile.products:
        if "from_prices" in case and p.price_inr in want:
            assert p.price_from == (p.price_inr in case["from_prices"]), f"price_from wrong for {p.name} ({p.price_inr})"
    page = render_site(profile, shop="lw-preflight")
    assert '<meta name="lw-shop" content="lw-preflight">' in page
    assert html.escape(profile.name) in page or profile.name in page
    for p in profile.products:
        assert format_inr(p.price_inr) in page, f"{p.name}: price not on the page"
        assert html.escape(p.name) in page or p.name in page, f"{p.name}: not on the page"
        if p.price_from:
            assert f"<small>from </small>{format_inr(p.price_inr)}" in page


def run_reader(client, rec) -> dict:
    first = None
    for sid in READERS:
        case = json.loads((HARD_FIXTURES / f"{sid}.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        files = None
        if case.get("photo"):
            files = {"photo": (case["photo"], (HARD_FIXTURES / case["photo"]).read_bytes(), "image/jpeg")}
            case["expected_prices"] = list(case["expected_prices"].values())
        n = len(rec.replies)
        r = client.post("/api/businesses", data={"description": case["description"], "price_list": case["price_list"]},
                        files=files, headers={"Origin": ORIGIN})
        assert r.status_code == 201, f"{sid}: {r.status_code} {r.text[:300]}"
        assert "x-assistant-note" not in r.headers, f"{sid}: fell back to a sample ({r.headers['x-assistant-note']})"
        assert len(rec.replies) == n + 1, f"{sid}: {len(rec.replies) - n} live calls (a retry means a bad first reply)"

        raw = rec.replies[-1][1]

def run_namer(client, rec, biz) -> None:

    assert r.status_code == 200, f"namer: {r.status_code} {r.text[:300]}"
    assert "x-assistant-note" not in r.headers, "namer: fell back to sample names"
    names = r.json()
    assert names and all(n["domain"] and n["price_usd"] is not None for n in names), names
    fixture, raw = rec.replies[-1]
    save("namer_tiffin_hinglish", raw)
    print(f"namer: ok · {[n['domain'] for n in names]} (asked as {fixture}) · saved")


def run_policy(claude, rec) -> None:

        n = len(rec.replies)
        v = policy_check(claude, Profile.model_validate(case["profile"]))
        assert v.by == "claude" and len(rec.replies) == n + 1, f"policy:{case['id']}: not answered live (by {v.by}: {v.reason})"

def run_doctor(client, rec, biz) -> None:
    admin = {"X-Admin-Token": ADMIN_TOKEN}
    csrf = {"Origin": ORIGIN}
    r = client.put(f"/api/businesses/{biz['id']}", json={"profile": biz["profile"], "subdomain": "meera"}, headers=csrf)
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text[:300]
    p = client.post(f"/api/businesses/{biz['id']}/plans", json={"mode": "sandbox", "domain": None}, headers=csrf)
    assert p.status_code == 201, p.text[:300]
    a = client.post(f"/api/plans/{p.json()['id']}/approve", json={"approved_by": "Preflight"}, headers=csrf)
    assert a.status_code == 200, a.text[:300]
    assert client.get(f"/api/plans/{p.json()['id']}").json()["status"] == "done"
    r = client.put(f"/api/admin/businesses/{biz['id']}/demo-fault", json={"fault": "a_record"}, headers=admin)
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text[:300]
    n = len(rec.replies)
    assert client.post(f"/api/businesses/{biz['id']}/checks", headers=csrf).status_code == 202
    rep = client.get(f"/api/businesses/{biz['id']}/report").json()
    turns = [(f, d) for f, d in rec.replies[n:] if f.startswith("investigate_site_points")]
    repairs = [x for x in rep["run"]["repairs"] if x.get("doctor")]
    assert turns and repairs, f"the Doctor didn't investigate: {json.dumps(rep['run'])[:600]}"

    assert d["source"] == "assistant" and d["fix_id"] == "repoint_site" and d["trace"], d
    assert all(c["passed"] for c in rep["run"]["checks"]), [(c["check"], c["passed"]) for c in rep["run"]["checks"]]

        old.unlink()
    for f, data in turns:
        save(f, data)
    looks = ", ".join(t["tool"] for t in d["trace"])
    print(f"doctor:a_record: ok · looked at [{looks}] -> {d['fix_id']} · {d['finding'][:120]!r} · saved {len(turns)} turn(s)")


def main(args: list[str]) -> int:
    if os.environ.get("CLAUDE_MODE") != "live":
        print("Set CLAUDE_MODE=live in this command's environment (not in .env).")
        return 2
    parts = args or ["reader", "namer", "policy", "doctor"]
    base = get_settings()
    db = ROOT / "replay" / "raw" / "preflight_s11c.db"
    settings = Settings(_env_file=None, anthropic_api_key=base.anthropic_api_key, claude_mode="live",
                        claude_model_strong=base.claude_model_strong, claude_model_cheap=base.claude_model_cheap,
                        claude_max_tokens=base.claude_max_tokens, claude_daily_spend_cap_usd=CAP_USD,
                        database_url=f"sqlite:///{db.as_posix()}", use_fakes=True, monitor_enabled=False,
                        admin_token=ADMIN_TOKEN, dev_mode=True, visitor_describes_per_day=1000,
                        visitor_launches_per_day=1000)
    engine = make_engine(settings.database_url)
    init_db(engine)
    with Session(engine) as s:
        before = spent_today_usd(s)
    rec = Recording(LiveClaudeClient(settings, engine))
    claude = FallbackClaudeClient(rec)
    integ = fake_integrations(settings)
    app = create_app(run_lifespan=False)

    def _session():
        with Session(engine) as s:
            yield s

    app.dependency_overrides.update({get_settings: lambda: settings, get_session: _session, get_claude: lambda: claude,
                                     get_integrations: lambda: integ, get_practice_integrations: lambda: integ})
    status = 0
    with TestClient(app) as client:
        try:
            biz = None
            if "reader" in parts:
                biz = run_reader(client, rec)
            if "namer" in parts or "doctor" in parts:
                if biz is None:  # a shop from a saved reply: no Reader call is spent on it
                    from app.agents.claude_client import FixtureClaudeClient
                    app.dependency_overrides[get_claude] = lambda: FixtureClaudeClient()
                    biz = client.post("/api/businesses", data={"description": "x", "price_list": "y"},
                                      headers={"Origin": ORIGIN}).json()
                    app.dependency_overrides[get_claude] = lambda: claude
            if "namer" in parts:
                run_namer(client, rec, biz)
            if "policy" in parts:
                run_policy(claude, rec)
            if "doctor" in parts:
                run_doctor(client, rec, biz)
        except AssertionError as e:
            print(f"FAILED: {str(e)[:900]}")
            raw = rec.live_client.last_raw
            if raw:
                out = ROOT / "replay" / "raw" / "claude"
                out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                (out / "preflight_last.json").write_text(json.dumps(raw, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
                print("  last raw reply saved to replay/raw/claude/preflight_last.json")
            status = 1
    with Session(engine) as s:
        after = spent_today_usd(s)
    print(f"{len(rec.replies)} live call(s) · spend this run ${after - before:.4f} · this part today ${after:.4f} (cap ${CAP_USD:.2f})")
    return status


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main(sys.argv[1:]))

"""S11c pre-flight: run the app's OWN Claude paths against the live API once, check every reply, save fixtures.

    cd backend && CLAUDE_MODE=live ../.venv/Scripts/python ../scripts/preflight_live.py [reader] [namer] [policy] [doctor]

What runs (no arguments = all four parts), all through the app's routes or service functions:
  reader  POST /api/businesses for 3 fresh sellers + the handwritten photo; prices, tidy-up, the shop page renders
  namer   GET /api/businesses/<id>/names for the first shop
  policy  policy_check() on the 5 cases in tests/fixtures/policy_cases.json (the verdict must match `expect`)
  doctor  a practice launch, the `a_record` fault, "Check again": the investigating Doctor must look and re-point

Money: everything is recorded in a scratch database (replay/raw/preflight_s11c.db, git-ignored) whose daily cap is
$0.25, so the cap holds across re-runs on the same day. GoDaddy, DNS and mail are the pretend world. The key is read
from .env by the app's Settings and never printed. Stops at the first failure (re-run only the parts that are left).
"""

import html
import json
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "backend"))

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient  # noqa: E402
from sqlmodel import Session  # noqa: E402

from app.agents.claude_client import FIXTURE_DIR, FallbackClaudeClient, LiveClaudeClient, spent_today_usd  # noqa: E402
from app.agents.policy import policy_check  # noqa: E402
from app.agents.reader import HARD_FIXTURES, Profile  # noqa: E402
from app.config import Settings, get_settings  # noqa: E402
from app.db import get_session, init_db, make_engine  # noqa: E402
from app.integrations import fake_integrations, get_integrations, get_practice_integrations  # noqa: E402
from app.main import create_app  # noqa: E402
from app.routers.businesses import get_claude  # noqa: E402
from app.sites.render import format_inr, render_site  # noqa: E402

CAP_USD = 0.25
ADMIN_TOKEN = "preflight-admin-token-0123456789"
ORIGIN = "http://localhost"
READERS = ["tiffin_hinglish", "candle_note", "tailor_from", "handwritten_photo"]
CASES = json.loads((HARD_FIXTURES.parent / "policy_cases.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


class Recording:
    """Passes every call to live Claude and keeps (fixture name, reply)."""

    def __init__(self, live):
        self.live_client, self.replies = live, []

    def ask_json(self, **kw):
        data = self.live_client.ask_json(**kw)
        self.replies.append((kw["fixture"], data))
        return data


def save(name: str, data: dict) -> None:
    (FIXTURE_DIR / f"{name}.json").write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


def check_shop(case: dict, profile: Profile) -> None:
    """Real prices kept, "from" prices marked, and the seller page renders with every item on it."""
    prices = sorted(p.price_inr for p in profile.products)
    want, optional = sorted(case["expected_prices"]), case.get("optional_prices", [])
    extra = list(prices)
    for p in want:
        assert p in extra, f"price {p} missing: got {prices}"
        extra.remove(p)
    assert all(p in optional for p in extra), f"unexpected prices {extra}: got {prices}"
    for p in profile.products:
        if "from_prices" in case and p.price_inr in want:
            assert p.price_from == (p.price_inr in case["from_prices"]), f"price_from wrong for {p.name} ({p.price_inr})"
    page = render_site(profile, shop="lw-preflight")
    assert '<meta name="lw-shop" content="lw-preflight">' in page
    assert html.escape(profile.name) in page or profile.name in page
    for p in profile.products:

        assert html.escape(p.name) in page or p.name in page, f"{p.name}: not on the page"
        if p.price_from:

def run_reader(client, rec) -> dict:
    first = None

        case = json.loads((HARD_FIXTURES / f"{sid}.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        files = None

        n = len(rec.replies)
        r = client.post("/api/businesses", data={"description": case["description"], "price_list": case["price_list"]},
                        files=files, headers={"Origin": ORIGIN})
        assert r.status_code == 201, f"{sid}: {r.status_code} {r.text[:300]}"
        assert "x-assistant-note" not in r.headers, f"{sid}: fell back to a sample ({r.headers['x-assistant-note']})"
        assert len(rec.replies) == n + 1, f"{sid}: {len(rec.replies) - n} live calls (a retry means a bad first reply)"
        biz = r.json()
        raw = rec.replies[-1][1]
        Profile.model_validate(raw)  # the raw reply itself fits our schema
        check_shop(case, Profile.model_validate(biz["profile"]))
        save(f"reader_{sid}", raw)
        first = first or biz
        print(f"reader:{sid}: ok · {biz['profile']['name']!r} · {len(biz['profile']['products'])} items · saved")
    return first


def run_namer(client, rec, biz) -> None:
    r = client.get(f"/api/businesses/{biz['id']}/names")
    assert r.status_code == 200, f"namer: {r.status_code} {r.text[:300]}"
    assert "x-assistant-note" not in r.headers, "namer: fell back to sample names"
    names = r.json()
    assert names and all(n["domain"] and n["price_usd"] is not None for n in names), names
    fixture, raw = rec.replies[-1]
    save("namer_tiffin_hinglish", raw)
    print(f"namer: ok · {[n['domain'] for n in names]} (asked as {fixture}) · saved")


def run_policy(claude, rec) -> None:
    for case in CASES:
        n = len(rec.replies)
        v = policy_check(claude, Profile.model_validate(case["profile"]))
        assert v.by == "claude" and len(rec.replies) == n + 1, f"policy:{case['id']}: not answered live (by {v.by}: {v.reason})"
        raw = rec.replies[-1][1]
        got = "ok" if v.ok else "held"
        assert case["expect"] in ("any", got), f"policy:{case['id']}: expected {case['expect']}, got {got}: {v.reason}"
        bad = case.get("must_not_contain")
        assert not bad or bad not in json.dumps(raw), f"policy:{case['id']}: obeyed the injected text"
        save("policy_ok" if case["id"] == "normal" else f"policy_{case['id']}", raw)
        print(f"policy:{case['id']}: {got} · {v.reason[:110]!r} · saved")


def run_doctor(client, rec, biz) -> None:
    admin = {"X-Admin-Token": ADMIN_TOKEN}
    csrf = {"Origin": ORIGIN}
    r = client.put(f"/api/businesses/{biz['id']}", json={"profile": biz["profile"], "subdomain": "meera"}, headers=csrf)
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text[:300]
    p = client.post(f"/api/businesses/{biz['id']}/plans", json={"mode": "sandbox", "domain": None}, headers=csrf)
    assert p.status_code == 201, p.text[:300]
    a = client.post(f"/api/plans/{p.json()['id']}/approve", json={"approved_by": "Preflight"}, headers=csrf)
    assert a.status_code == 200, a.text[:300]
    assert client.get(f"/api/plans/{p.json()['id']}").json()["status"] == "done"
    r = client.put(f"/api/admin/businesses/{biz['id']}/demo-fault", json={"fault": "a_record"}, headers=admin)
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text[:300]
    n = len(rec.replies)
    assert client.post(f"/api/businesses/{biz['id']}/checks", headers=csrf).status_code == 202
    rep = client.get(f"/api/businesses/{biz['id']}/report").json()
    turns = [(f, d) for f, d in rec.replies[n:] if f.startswith("investigate_site_points")]
    repairs = [x for x in rep["run"]["repairs"] if x.get("doctor")]
    assert turns and repairs, f"the Doctor didn't investigate: {json.dumps(rep['run'])[:600]}"
    d = repairs[0]["doctor"]
    assert d["source"] == "assistant" and d["fix_id"] == "repoint_site" and d["trace"], d
    assert all(c["passed"] for c in rep["run"]["checks"]), [(c["check"], c["passed"]) for c in rep["run"]["checks"]]
    for old in FIXTURE_DIR.glob("investigate_site_points_t*.json"):
        old.unlink()
    for f, data in turns:
        save(f, data)
    looks = ", ".join(t["tool"] for t in d["trace"])
    print(f"doctor:a_record: ok · looked at [{looks}] -> {d['fix_id']} · {d['finding'][:120]!r} · saved {len(turns)} turn(s)")


def main(args: list[str]) -> int:

                        claude_max_tokens=base.claude_max_tokens, claude_daily_spend_cap_usd=CAP_USD,
                        database_url=f"sqlite:///{db.as_posix()}", use_fakes=True, monitor_enabled=False,

                    biz = client.post("/api/businesses", data={"description": "x", "price_list": "y"},
                                      headers={"Origin": ORIGIN}).json()
                    app.dependency_overrides[get_claude] = lambda: claude
            if "namer" in parts:
                run_namer(client, rec, biz)
            if "policy" in parts:
                run_policy(claude, rec)
            if "doctor" in parts:
                run_doctor(client, rec, biz)
        except AssertionError as e:
            print(f"FAILED: {str(e)[:900]}")
            raw = rec.live_client.last_raw
            if raw:
                out = ROOT / "replay" / "raw" / "claude"
                out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                (out / "preflight_last.json").write_text(json.dumps(raw, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")

    with Session(engine) as s:

    print(f"{len(rec.replies)} live call(s) · spend this run ${after - before:.4f} · this part today ${after:.4f} (cap ${CAP_USD:.2f})")
    return status

## s11c-preflight
"""Internal endpoints (called by Caddy on the private network, not exposed publicly)."""

from typing import Annotated

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query
from sqlmodel import Session

from app.config import Settings, get_settings
from app.db import get_session
from app.sites.hosts import HOSTNAME, business_for_host

router = APIRouter(prefix="/internal", tags=["internal"])


def is_allowed_tls_domain(domain: str, settings: Settings, session: Session) -> bool:
    """True only for the app domain and for shops that are live, real (not practice) and not paused."""
    d = domain.strip().lower().rstrip(".")
    if not HOSTNAME.match(d):
        return False
    if d == settings.app_domain.lower().rstrip("."):
        return True
    b = business_for_host(d, settings, session)  # only live, non-practice shops
    return b is not None and not b.paused


@router.get("/tls-ask")
def tls_ask(
    settings: Annotated[Settings, Depends(get_settings)],
    session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)],
    domain: Annotated[str, Query(max_length=253)] = "",
) -> dict:
    """Caddy on-demand TLS `ask` hook: 200 = issue a certificate, anything else = refuse."""
    if not is_allowed_tls_domain(domain, settings, session):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="unknown domain")
    return {"ok": True}
"""Map a request's Host header to a seller business (or to the app itself)."""

import re
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

from sqlmodel import Session, select

from app.config import Settings
from app.models import Business

HOSTNAME = re.compile(r"^(?=.{1,253}$)([a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?)(\.[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?)*$")
SLUG = re.compile(r"^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,28}[a-z0-9]$")  # 3-30 characters
RESERVED_SUBDOMAINS = {"www", "app", "api", "admin", "mail", "email", "hello", "support", "help", "status", "login",
                       "auth", "static", "cdn", "assets", "docs", "blog", "godaddy", "airo", "launchwitness", "test",
                       "demo", "internal", "smtp", "imap", "ftp", "build", "ns1", "ns2", "autodiscover", "webmail",
                       "pay", "payment", "payments", "secure", "account", "accounts", "billing", "preview", "report"}
# Names that could pass a shop off as a well-known brand, bank or payment app.
BRAND_DENYLIST = {"godaddy", "airo", "paytm", "phonepe", "gpay", "googlepay", "google", "amazon", "flipkart",
                  "whatsapp", "instagram", "facebook", "meta", "razorpay", "upi", "bhim", "npci", "sbi", "hdfc",
                  "icici", "axis", "kotak", "paypal", "apple", "microsoft", "netflix", "swiggy", "zomato", "meesho"}


def slug_problem(slug: str) -> str | None:
    """None when `slug` may be a shop name; else one plain sentence saying why not."""
    if slug.startswith(("_", "xn--")) or not SLUG.match(slug):
        return ("A shop address needs 3 to 30 characters: small letters, numbers and dashes, "
                "starting and ending with a letter or number.")
    if slug in RESERVED_SUBDOMAINS:
        return "That shop address is reserved. Please pick another."
    parts = set(slug.split("-"))
    if parts & BRAND_DENYLIST or any(slug.startswith(b) for b in BRAND_DENYLIST if len(b) >= 6):
        return "That shop address looks like a well-known brand's name. Please pick one that is clearly yours."
    return None


def normalize_host(host: str) -> str:
    """'Meera.LocalHost:8000.' -> 'meera.localhost'"""
    h = host.strip().lower()
    if h.startswith("["):  # IPv6 literal
        return h
    return h.split(":", 1)[0].rstrip(".")


def subdomain_label(host: str, settings: Settings) -> str | None:
    """The single label under APP_DOMAIN, e.g. 'meera' for meera.localhost; else None."""
    suffix = "." + settings.app_domain.lower().rstrip(".")
    if host.endswith(suffix):
        label = host[: -len(suffix)]
        if label and "." not in label:
            return label
    return None


def is_public(b: Business) -> bool:
    """A shop is on the public internet only when it is launched for real. Drafts and practice
    shops are seen only by their owner, through the preview route."""
    return b.status == "live" and not b.practice


def business_for_host(host: str, settings: Settings, session: Session) -> Business | None:
    """The PUBLIC shop for this Host (live, not practice), paused or not. None for anything else,
    so a draft, a practice shop and a name nobody took all look the same from outside."""
    h = normalize_host(host)
    if not HOSTNAME.match(h) or h == settings.app_domain.lower().rstrip("."):
        return None
    label = subdomain_label(h, settings)
    q = select(Business).where(Business.status == "live", Business.practice == False)  # noqa: E712
    q = q.where(Business.subdomain == label) if label is not None else q.where(Business.domain == h)
    return session.exec(q).first()


def site_url(subdomain: str, settings: Settings) -> str:
    """Public URL of a seller's sandbox site, using APP_BASE_URL's scheme and port."""
    base = urlsplit(settings.app_base_url)
    port = f":{base.port}" if base.port else ""
    return f"{base.scheme or 'http'}://{subdomain}.{settings.app_domain}{port}/"
# PROD Caddyfile (also used by the local production-like stack, see deploy/README.md).
#
# - The app on {$APP_DOMAIN} (automatic HTTPS + HSTS).
# - Shops (<slug>.{$APP_DOMAIN}) on on-demand TLS: before issuing any certificate Caddy asks the app
#   (/internal/tls-ask), which says yes only for the app domain and live, real, unpaused shops.
# - /internal/* answers 404 from outside on EVERY host (the app also refuses it for public host names).
# - Caddy passes the Host header through and sets X-Forwarded-For to the real client address. No
#   trusted_proxies are configured, so whatever X-Forwarded-For a client sends is replaced, not trusted.
#   The app (app/safety/access.py::visitor_id) reads the LAST entry: that is always Caddy's.
#
# Env (substituted when Caddy reads this file):
#   APP_DOMAIN           launchwitness.com (local: launchwitness.localhost)
#   ACME_CA              optional; set to Let's Encrypt STAGING for first tests (see docs/NEXT_SESSION_VPS.md)
#   CADDY_EXTRA_GLOBAL   optional; the local stack sets `local_certs` (Caddy's own CA instead of Let's Encrypt)

{
	{$CADDY_EXTRA_GLOBAL}
	acme_ca {$ACME_CA:https://acme-v02.api.letsencrypt.org/directory}
	on_demand_tls {
		ask http://app:8000/internal/tls-ask
	}
	servers {
		timeouts {
			read_header 10s
			read_body 30s
			write 90s
			idle 2m
		}
	}
}

(app) {
	@internal path /internal /internal/*
	respond @internal 404

	# Price-list photos are at most 5 MB (app/agents/reader.py); leave room for the form around it.
	request_body {
		max_size 8MB
	}
	encode gzip
	header -Server

	reverse_proxy app:8000 {
		transport http {
			dial_timeout 5s
			response_header_timeout 90s
		}
	}
}

# The app itself.
{$APP_DOMAIN} {
	header Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=31536000"
	import app
}

# Shops: <slug>.{$APP_DOMAIN}. One A record per live shop (no wildcard), certificate on first visit.
https:// {
	tls {
		on_demand
	}
	import app
}

SLUG = re.compile(r"^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,28}[a-z0-9]$")  # 3-30 characters
RESERVED_SUBDOMAINS = {"www", "app", "api", "admin", "mail", "email", "hello", "support", "help", "status", "login",
                       "auth", "static", "cdn", "assets", "docs", "blog", "godaddy", "airo", "launchwitness", "test",
                       "demo", "internal", "smtp", "imap", "ftp", "build", "ns1", "ns2", "autodiscover", "webmail",
                       "pay", "payment", "payments", "secure", "account", "accounts", "billing", "preview", "report"}
# Names that could pass a shop off as a well-known brand, bank or payment app.
BRAND_DENYLIST = {"godaddy", "airo", "paytm", "phonepe", "gpay", "googlepay", "google", "amazon", "flipkart",
                  "whatsapp", "instagram", "facebook", "meta", "razorpay", "upi", "bhim", "npci", "sbi", "hdfc",
                  "icici", "axis", "kotak", "paypal", "apple", "microsoft", "netflix", "swiggy", "zomato", "meesho"}


def slug_problem(slug: str) -> str | None:
    """None when `slug` may be a shop name; else one plain sentence saying why not."""
    if slug.startswith(("_", "xn--")) or not SLUG.match(slug):
        return ("A shop address needs 3 to 30 characters: small letters, numbers and dashes, "
                "starting and ending with a letter or number.")
    if slug in RESERVED_SUBDOMAINS:
        return "That shop address is reserved. Please pick another."
    parts = set(slug.split("-"))
    if parts & BRAND_DENYLIST or any(slug.startswith(b) for b in BRAND_DENYLIST if len(b) >= 6):
        return "That shop address looks like a well-known brand's name. Please pick one that is clearly yours."
    return None


def normalize_host(host: str) -> str:
    """'Meera.LocalHost:8000.' -> 'meera.localhost'"""
    h = host.strip().lower()
    if h.startswith("["):  # IPv6 literal
        return h
    return h.split(":", 1)[0].rstrip(".")


def subdomain_label(host: str, settings: Settings) -> str | None:
    """The single label under APP_DOMAIN, e.g. 'meera' for meera.localhost; else None."""
    suffix = "." + settings.app_domain.lower().rstrip(".")
    if host.endswith(suffix):
        label = host[: -len(suffix)]
        if label and "." not in label:
            return label
    return None


def is_public(b: Business) -> bool:
    """A shop is on the public internet only when it is launched for real. Drafts and practice
    shops are seen only by their owner, through the preview route."""
    return b.status == "live" and not b.practice


def business_for_host(host: str, settings: Settings, session: Session) -> Business | None:
    """The PUBLIC shop for this Host (live, not practice), paused or not. None for anything else,
    so a draft, a practice shop and a name nobody took all look the same from outside."""
    h = normalize_host(host)
    if not HOSTNAME.match(h) or h == settings.app_domain.lower().rstrip("."):
        return None
    label = subdomain_label(h, settings)
    q = select(Business).where(Business.status == "live", Business.practice == False)  # noqa: E712
    q = q.where(Business.subdomain == label) if label is not None else q.where(Business.domain == h)
    return session.exec(q).first()


def site_url(subdomain: str, settings: Settings) -> str:
    """Public URL of a seller's sandbox site, using APP_BASE_URL's scheme and port."""
    base = urlsplit(settings.app_base_url)
    port = f":{base.port}" if base.port else ""
    return f"{base.scheme or 'http'}://{subdomain}.{settings.app_domain}{port}/"
# PROD Caddyfile (also used by the local production-like stack, see deploy/README.md).
#
# - The app on {$APP_DOMAIN} (automatic HTTPS + HSTS).
# - Shops (<slug>.{$APP_DOMAIN}) on on-demand TLS: before issuing any certificate Caddy asks the app
#   (/internal/tls-ask), which says yes only for the app domain and live, real, unpaused shops.
# - /internal/* answers 404 from outside on EVERY host (the app also refuses it for public host names).
# - Caddy passes the Host header through and sets X-Forwarded-For to the real client address. No
#   trusted_proxies are configured, so whatever X-Forwarded-For a client sends is replaced, not trusted.
#   The app (app/safety/access.py::visitor_id) reads the LAST entry: that is always Caddy's.
#
# Env (substituted when Caddy reads this file):
#   APP_DOMAIN           launchwitness.com (local: launchwitness.localhost)
#   ACME_CA              optional; set to Let's Encrypt STAGING for first tests (see docs/NEXT_SESSION_VPS.md)
#   CADDY_EXTRA_GLOBAL   optional; the local stack sets `local_certs` (Caddy's own CA instead of Let's Encrypt)

{
	{$CADDY_EXTRA_GLOBAL}
	acme_ca {$ACME_CA:https://acme-v02.api.letsencrypt.org/directory}
	on_demand_tls {
		ask http://app:8000/internal/tls-ask
	}
	servers {
		timeouts {
			read_header 10s
			read_body 30s
			write 90s
			idle 2m
		}
	}
}

(app) {
	@internal path /internal /internal/*
	respond @internal 404

	# Price-list photos are at most 5 MB (app/agents/reader.py); leave room for the form around it.
	request_body {
		max_size 8MB
	}
	encode gzip
	header -Server

	reverse_proxy app:8000 {
		transport http {
			dial_timeout 5s
			response_header_timeout 90s
		}
	}
}

# The app itself.
{$APP_DOMAIN} {
	header Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=31536000"
	import app
}

# Shops: <slug>.{$APP_DOMAIN}. One A record per live shop (no wildcard), certificate on first visit.
https:// {
	tls {
		on_demand
	}
	import app
}

def write_change(ctx: Ctx, ch: dict, after: list[dict] | None = None) -> None:
    assert_can_write(ctx, ch["zone"], ch["name"])
    if latest_backup(ctx.session, ctx.plan) is None:
        raise StepFailed("Stopped: we couldn't save a copy of your settings first, so nothing was changed.",
                         "no DnsBackup for this plan")
    records = after if after is not None else ch["after"]
    if mail_write_decision(ctx, ch, records) == "keep":
        audit.record(ctx.session, actor="executor", action="dns_write", target=f"{ch['type']} {ch['name']} @ {ch['zone']}",
                     result="kept", business_id=ctx.business.id, detail="a working value is already there; left as it is")
        return
    if ch["type"] == "TXT" and ch["name"] == "@":  # the write replaces every TXT there: carry over what is live now
        have = {str(r.get("data", "")) for r in records}
        records = [r for r in ctx.integ.godaddy.get_records(ch["zone"]) if r["type"] == "TXT" and r["name"] == "@"
                   and str(r.get("data", "")) not in have and not str(r.get("data", "")).lower().startswith("v=spf1")
                   ] + list(records)
    ctx.integ.godaddy.set_records(ch["zone"], ch["type"], ch["name"], records)
    audit.record(ctx.session, actor="executor", action="dns_write", target=f"{ch['type']} {ch['name']} @ {ch['zone']}",
                 result="ok", business_id=ctx.business.id, detail=json.dumps([r.get("data") for r in records])[:500])


def restore_change(ctx: Ctx, ch: dict) -> None:
    """Put one (type, name) back exactly as it was in the plan's backup (delete if it didn't exist)."""
    backup = latest_backup(ctx.session, ctx.plan)
    if backup is None:
        raise StepFailed("There's no saved copy to undo from.", "no DnsBackup")
    assert_can_write(ctx, ch["zone"], ch["name"])
    before = [r for r in json.loads(backup.records_json) if r["type"] == ch["type"] and r["name"] == ch["name"]]
    if before:
        ctx.integ.godaddy.set_records(ch["zone"], ch["type"], ch["name"], before)
    else:
        ctx.integ.godaddy.delete_records(ch["zone"], ch["type"], ch["name"])
    audit.record(ctx.session, actor="executor", action="dns_restore", target=f"{ch['type']} {ch['name']} @ {ch['zone']}",
                 result="ok", business_id=ctx.business.id, detail=f"from backup #{backup.id}")


# ---------- steps ----------

"""Zone hygiene for our own shop zone (S10, feature 16, scoped down).

Once a day we compare every A record on the app's domain with the shops in the database:
- **dangling**: a record for a shop name that is deleted, not live, or practice. Anyone who later takes that
  name would inherit a working address, and a stray record points customers at a "not found" page.

# ---------- real launches: live-shop cap and policy check ----------

def real_world(make_settings, engine, mailer, claude, **kw):
    server, practice = fake_integrations(make_settings()), fake_integrations(make_settings())
    server.fake = False
    app, settings = make_app(make_settings, engine, mailer, claude, server, practice=practice, use_fakes=False, **kw)
    return app, server


def approved_shop(c, engine, email="m@example.org", sub="meera"):
    sign_in(c, email)
    set_user(engine, email, status="approved")
    return meera(c, sub)


def real_approve(c, biz):
    ready_for_real(c, biz["id"])
    p = c.post(f"/api/businesses/{biz['id']}/plans", json={"mode": "sandbox", "real": True})
    assert p.status_code == 201, p.text
    return c.post(f"/api/plans/{p.json()['id']}/approve", json={"approved_by": "M"})


def test_live_shop_cap(make_settings, engine, mailer, claude):
    app, server = real_world(make_settings, engine, mailer, claude, max_live_shops=1)
    with Session(engine) as s:
        s.add(Business(name="Other", subdomain="other", status="live", practice=False))
        s.commit()
    with AppClient(app) as c:
        r = real_approve(c, approved_shop(c, engine))
    assert r.status_code == 409 and "live shops" in r.json()["detail"]
    assert server.godaddy.writes() == []


class Says:
    def __init__(self, reply=None, error=None):
        self.reply, self.error = reply, error

    def ask_json(self, **kw):
        if kw["fixture"] != "policy_ok":
            from app.agents.claude_client import FixtureClaudeClient
            return FixtureClaudeClient().ask_json(**kw)
        if self.error:
            raise self.error
        return self.reply


@pytest.mark.parametrize("claude_like", [
    Says({"ok": False, "reason": "This shop looks like it pretends to be a famous brand."}),
    Says(error=ClaudeUnavailable("down")),  # can't ask: held (fail closed)
    FallbackClaudeClient(Says(error=ClaudeUnavailable("down"))),  # live mode never answers from the saved sample
])
def test_policy_hold_blocks_a_real_launch(make_settings, engine, mailer, claude_like):
    app, server = real_world(make_settings, engine, mailer, claude_like)
    with AppClient(app) as c:
        biz = approved_shop(c, engine)
        r = real_approve(c, biz)
        assert r.status_code == 409 and "Nothing was launched" in r.json()["detail"]
    assert server.godaddy.writes() == []
    with Session(engine) as s:
        assert s.get(Business, biz["id"]).review == "held"
    assert events(engine, "policy_check")[-1].result == "held"


def test_policy_ok_and_team_can_clear_a_hold(make_settings, engine, mailer):
    held = Says({"ok": False, "reason": "Unclear."})
    app, server = real_world(make_settings, engine, mailer, held)
    with AppClient(app) as c:
        biz = approved_shop(c, engine)
        assert real_approve(c, biz).status_code == 409
        assert c.post(f"/api/admin/businesses/{biz['id']}/clear-review", headers=ADMIN).status_code == 200
        assert real_approve(c, biz).status_code == 200  # the team looked: no second policy call
    assert server.godaddy.writes() == [("set_records", "localhost", "A", "meera")]
    assert events(engine, "shop_review_cleared")

Staging certificates aren't trusted by browsers, but the staging CA has far higher rate limits, so the first
attempts (while DNS may still be spreading) can't burn the real quota (50 certificates per domain per week, 5 failed
validations per hostname per hour).

The app logs its self-check. Expect **no** `self-check [...]` lines. Each one names a wrong setting; fix it in `.env`
and run `lwc up -d`.

godaddy.com → launchwitness.com → DNS → edit **A `@`** → `<VPS_IP>`, TTL 600. Optionally add **A `www`** →

   then restores and compares row counts).

    def _maybe_fail(self, method: str) -> None:
        if self.fail_next.get(method, 0) > 0:
            self.fail_next[method] -= 1
            raise RuntimeError(f"fake {method} failure")

    def check_availability(self, domain: str) -> dict:
        self.calls.append(("check_availability", domain))
        if domain in self.available and domain not in self.owned:
            return {"domain": domain, "available": True, "price_usd": self.available[domain]}
        return {"domain": domain, "available": False}

        self.calls.append(("is_owned", domain))
        return domain in self.owned

        self.calls.append(("get_records", domain))
        self._maybe_fail("get_records")
        return [dict(r) for r in self.zones.get(domain, [])]

        assert_zone_write(self.app_domain, domain, rtype, name)
        self.calls.append(("set_records", domain, rtype, name))
        self._maybe_fail("set_records")
        keep = [r for r in self.zones.get(domain, []) if not (r["type"] == rtype and r["name"] == name)]
        self.zones[domain] = keep + [{**dict(r), "type": rtype, "name": name} for r in records]

    def delete_records(self, domain: str, rtype: str, name: str) -> None:

        self.zones[domain] = [r for r in self.zones.get(domain, []) if not (r["type"] == rtype and r["name"] == name)]

"""S11c: hosting failures nobody had tested.

1. DNS before TLS: a shop's first https request (which makes Caddy ask Let's Encrypt) can only happen after its
   address record is written AND every nameserver answers with our server; /internal/tls-ask says yes from exactly
   that point, and says no again if DNS stops pointing at us.
2. DNS_MODE=wildcard: the app neither writes nor reads GoDaddy for shops, and everything else still holds."""

import pytest
from sqlmodel import Session, select

from app.checks.dns_resolver import AuthoritativeResolver, FakeDnsResolver, points_here
from app.models import Business, Plan
from app.routers.internal import is_allowed_tls_domain
from app.zone_hygiene import approve, compare, scan
from tests.conftest import AppClient
from tests.test_s9_phase2_access import approved_shop, real_approve, real_world

HOST = "meera.localhost"
IP = "127.0.0.1"


class Watched:
    """Wraps the stand-in real world's DNS and web probe and writes down the order things happen in."""

    def __init__(self, server, engine, settings_of):
        self.log: list[tuple] = []
        self.server, self.engine, self.settings_of = server, engine, settings_of
        dns, http = server.dns, server.http
        outer = self

        class Dns:
            hide = dns.hide

            def resolve(self, name, rtype):
                got = dns.resolve(name, rtype)
                if rtype == "A" and name == HOST:
                    outer.log.append(("dns", IP in got, outer.live()))
                return got

        real_fetch = http.fetch

        def fetch(url):
            if url.startswith(f"https://{HOST}"):
                outer.log.append(("https", IP in dns.resolve(HOST, "A"), outer.live()))
            return real_fetch(url)

        server.dns, http.fetch = Dns(), fetch

    def live(self) -> bool:
        """What tls-ask would say from the database alone, right now."""
        with Session(self.engine) as s:
            return is_allowed_tls_domain(HOST, self.settings_of(), s)


def launch(make_settings, engine, mailer, claude, before=None, **kw):
    app, server = real_world(make_settings, engine, mailer, claude, **kw)
    watch = Watched(server, engine, lambda: make_settings(**kw))
    if before:
        before(server)
    with AppClient(app) as c:
        biz = approved_shop(c, engine)
        r = real_approve(c, biz)
        assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    with Session(engine) as s:
        plan = s.exec(select(Plan).where(Plan.business_id == biz["id"]).order_by(Plan.id.desc())).first()
        return app, server, watch, biz, plan.status


# ---------- 1. DNS before TLS ----------

def test_first_https_request_comes_only_after_the_record_is_written_and_answered(make_settings, engine, mailer, claude):
    _app, server, watch, _biz, status = launch(make_settings, engine, mailer, claude)
    assert status == "done"
    kinds = [e[0] for e in watch.log]
    assert "https" in kinds and "dns" in kinds
    first_https = kinds.index("https")
    # Before the first https request: the nameserver was asked, it answered with our server, and at the moment of
    # that answer the shop was NOT yet approved for a certificate.
    before = watch.log[:first_https]
    assert ("dns", True, False) in before
    # At the first https request: the address points at us and tls-ask says yes (or the padlock check could never pass).
    assert watch.log[first_https] == ("https", True, True)
    # tls-ask never said yes while the nameserver didn't answer with our server.
    assert not any(kind == "dns" and not pointed and allowed for kind, pointed, allowed in watch.log)
    assert server.godaddy.writes() == [("set_records", "localhost", "A", "meera")]


def test_no_https_request_and_no_certificate_while_dns_has_not_spread(make_settings, engine, mailer, claude):
    _app, server, watch, _biz, status = launch(make_settings, engine, mailer, claude,
                                               before=lambda sv: sv.dns.hide.add((HOST, "A")))
    assert status == "failed"  # "the internet hasn't picked up the new address yet": press Resume
    assert [e for e in watch.log if e[0] == "https"] == []
    assert watch.log and all(e == ("dns", False, False) for e in watch.log)
    assert server.http.calls == []
    assert watch.live() is False


def fake_ns(answers: dict):
    """An AuthoritativeResolver over two pretend nameservers; `answers` maps the server's IP to its A answer
    (an Exception = that server doesn't answer)."""
    finder = FakeDnsResolver({("localhost", "NS"): ["ns1.example.", "ns2.example."],
                              ("ns1.example", "A"): ["10.0.0.1"], ("ns2.example", "A"): ["10.0.0.2"]})

    def query(name, rtype, ip):
        got = answers[ip]
        if isinstance(got, Exception):
            raise got
        return got

"""GoDaddy REST API wrapper (Domains + DNS). OTE sandbox by default.

DNS writes are always scoped to ONE (type, name) pair (`set_records` /
`delete_records`), never a whole-zone replace, so a launch can't wipe records
it didn't plan. Purchases are not implemented in the real client: they are done
by the owner on godaddy.com, and any future code path must go through
`app.safety.spend_guard.authorize_purchase` first.
"""

from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
from typing import Protocol

import httpx

from app.config import Settings

BASE_URLS = {
    "ote": "https://api.ote-godaddy.com",
    "prod": "https://api.godaddy.com",
}

DnsRecord = dict  # {"type": "A", "name": "@", "data": "1.2.3.4", "ttl": 600, "priority"?: 10}


class PurchaseNotSupported(RuntimeError):
    pass


class AppZoneWriteRefused(RuntimeError):
    """A write to the app's own domain that is not an A record for one shop name."""


def assert_zone_write(app_domain: str, domain: str, rtype: str, name: str) -> None:
    """Hard guard, inside the client itself: on the app's own domain (which also carries the app's
    website and email), code may only write an A record for one shop name. Never @, *, www, a
    reserved name, MX, TXT, CNAME or any mail record, whatever the caller asks for."""
    from app.sites.hosts import slug_problem

    if domain.lower().rstrip(".") != app_domain.lower().rstrip("."):
        return
    if rtype.upper() != "A" or slug_problem(name) is not None:
        raise AppZoneWriteRefused(f"refused {rtype} {name} on {domain}: only A records for shop names may be written")


class GoDaddy(Protocol):
    env: str

    def check_availability(self, domain: str) -> dict: ...
    def is_owned(self, domain: str) -> bool: ...
    def get_records(self, domain: str) -> list[DnsRecord]: ...
    def set_records(self, domain: str, rtype: str, name: str, records: list[DnsRecord]) -> None: ...
    def delete_records(self, domain: str, rtype: str, name: str) -> None: ...
    def purchase_domain(self, domain: str, price_usd: float) -> dict: ...
    def domain_expires(self, domain: str) -> datetime | None: ...


class GoDaddyClient:
    """Real client. `env` comes from GODADDY_ENV; prod only when set explicitly."""

    def __init__(self, settings: Settings, transport: httpx.BaseTransport | None = None):
        self.env = settings.godaddy_env
        self.app_domain = settings.app_domain
        if self.env == "prod":
            key, secret = settings.godaddy_api_key, settings.godaddy_api_secret
        else:
            key, secret = settings.godaddy_ote_api_key, settings.godaddy_ote_api_secret
        self.base_url = BASE_URLS[self.env]
        self._http = httpx.Client(
            base_url=self.base_url,
            headers={
                "Authorization": f"sso-key {key.get_secret_value()}:{secret.get_secret_value()}",
                "Accept": "application/json",
            },
            timeout=20.0,
            transport=transport,
        )

    def check_availability(self, domain: str) -> dict:
        r = self._http.get("/v1/domains/available", params={"domain": domain})
        r.raise_for_status()
        return r.json()

    def is_owned(self, domain: str) -> bool:
        """True only if the domain is in this GoDaddy account AND its status is ACTIVE."""
        r = self._http.get(f"/v1/domains/{domain}")
        if r.status_code == 404:
            return False
        r.raise_for_status()
        return str(r.json().get("status", "")).upper() == "ACTIVE"

    def get_records(self, domain: str) -> list[DnsRecord]:
        r = self._http.get(f"/v1/domains/{domain}/records")
        r.raise_for_status()
        return r.json()

    def set_records(self, domain: str, rtype: str, name: str, records: list[DnsRecord]) -> None:
        """Replace all records of one type+name (PUT /v1/domains/{d}/records/{type}/{name})."""
        assert_zone_write(self.app_domain, domain, rtype, name)
        body = [{k: v for k, v in rec.items() if k not in ("type", "name")} for rec in records]
        r = self._http.put(f"/v1/domains/{domain}/records/{rtype}/{name}", json=body)
        r.raise_for_status()

    def delete_records(self, domain: str, rtype: str, name: str) -> None:
        assert_zone_write(self.app_domain, domain, rtype, name)
        r = self._http.delete(f"/v1/domains/{domain}/records/{rtype}/{name}")
        if r.status_code != 404:
            r.raise_for_status()

    def purchase_domain(self, domain: str, price_usd: float) -> dict:
        raise PurchaseNotSupported("Domains are bought by the owner on godaddy.com; the app only adopts them.")

    def domain_expires(self, domain: str) -> datetime | None:
        """Registration end date from GET /v1/domains/{domain} ("expires"). TODO(real): verify field on prod."""
        r = self._http.get(f"/v1/domains/{domain}")
        if r.status_code == 404:
            return None
        r.raise_for_status()
        value = r.json().get("expires")

"""S11c pre-flight: ONE real DNS write through the app's own guarded GoDaddyClient, then undo it.

    cd backend && ../.venv/Scripts/python ../scripts/preflight_dns_write.py --yes-owner-approved [--domain launchwitness.com]

Steps (the HTTP status of every GoDaddy call is printed; keys and record values never are):
  1. GET the whole zone and save it (replay/raw/dns_preflight_<time>.json, git-ignored). This is the backup.
  2. PUT  A lw-preflight -> 192.0.2.1 (an address reserved for documentation: it leads nowhere).
  3. Ask every nameserver of the zone until all of them answer 192.0.2.1.
  4. DELETE A lw-preflight, and ask every nameserver until none answers.
  5. GET the zone again and compare it with the backup, byte for byte.
A 401/403 on any call stops the run there (nothing further is tried): then Wednesday uses DNS_MODE=wildcard.
Nothing else in the zone is touched: the client itself refuses anything but an A record for one shop-shaped name.
This is the owner-approved exception to "no DNS writes outside a launch"; it needs the flag above every time.
"""

import json
import sys
import time
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "backend"))

import httpx  # noqa: E402

from app.checks.dns_resolver import AuthoritativeResolver  # noqa: E402
from app.config import get_settings  # noqa: E402
from app.godaddy.client import GoDaddyClient  # noqa: E402

NAME, IP, TTL = "lw-preflight", "192.0.2.1", 600
WAIT_SECONDS, POLL = 180, 10


def main(args: list[str]) -> int:
    if "--yes-owner-approved" not in args:
        print("This writes one real DNS record and removes it. Pass --yes-owner-approved to run.")
        return 2
    domain = args[args.index("--domain") + 1] if "--domain" in args else "launchwitness.com"
    settings = get_settings().model_copy(update={"godaddy_env": "prod", "app_domain": domain})
    if not settings.godaddy_api_key.get_secret_value() or not settings.godaddy_api_secret.get_secret_value():
        print("GODADDY_API_KEY / GODADDY_API_SECRET are empty in .env: nothing was called.")
        return 2
    client = GoDaddyClient(settings)
    calls: list[tuple[str, str, int]] = []
    bodies: list[bytes] = []

    def seen(response: httpx.Response) -> None:
        response.read()
        calls.append((response.request.method, response.request.url.path, response.status_code))
        print(f"  {response.request.method:6} {response.request.url.path} -> {response.status_code}")
        if response.request.method == "GET" and response.request.url.path.endswith("/records"):
            bodies.append(response.content)

    client._http.event_hooks["response"].append(seen)
    dns = AuthoritativeResolver()
    host = f"{NAME}.{domain}"

    def everywhere() -> list[tuple[str, list[str] | None]]:
        return dns.resolve_all(host, "A")

    def wait_for(want_present: bool) -> bool:
        deadline = time.monotonic() + WAIT_SECONDS
        while True:
            answers = everywhere()
            ok = bool(answers) and all(v is not None and ((IP in v) if want_present else (v == [])) for _s, v in answers)
            print("  nameservers: " + "; ".join(f"{s} = {'no answer' if v is None else (', '.join(v) or 'nothing')}"
                                                 for s, v in answers))
            if ok or time.monotonic() > deadline:
                return ok
            time.sleep(POLL)

    def refused(e: Exception) -> bool:
        return isinstance(e, httpx.HTTPStatusError) and e.response.status_code in (401, 403)

    print(f"1. Backup: read the whole zone of {domain}")
    try:
        records = client.get_records(domain)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"STOPPED at the read ({type(e).__name__}). " + ("GoDaddy refuses this account's API: use DNS_MODE=wildcard."
                                                             if refused(e) else "Nothing was written."))
        return 1
    backup = ROOT / "replay" / "raw" / f"dns_preflight_{datetime.now(UTC):%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ}.json"
    backup.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    backup.write_bytes(bodies[0])
    print(f"   {len(records)} records saved to {backup.relative_to(ROOT)} ({len(bodies[0])} bytes)")
    if any(str(r.get("name", "")).lower() == NAME for r in records):
        print(f"STOPPED: a record named {NAME} already exists. Nothing was written.")
        return 1
    print("   nameservers before the write:")
    if not wait_for(False):
        print("STOPPED: the nameservers already answer for this name, or didn't answer. Nothing was written.")
        return 1

    status, written = 0, False
    try:
        print(f"2. Create: A {NAME} -> {IP}")
        try:
            client.set_records(domain, "A", NAME, [{"data": IP, "ttl": TTL}])
            written = True
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"STOPPED at the write ({type(e).__name__}). " + ("GoDaddy refuses writes: use DNS_MODE=wildcard."
                                                                  if refused(e) else "See the status above."))
            return 1
        print("3. Confirm at every nameserver")
        if not wait_for(True):
            print(f"   NOT confirmed within {WAIT_SECONDS}s")
            status = 1
    finally:
        if written:
            print(f"4. Delete: A {NAME}")
            try:
                client.delete_records(domain, "A", NAME)
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"   DELETE FAILED ({type(e).__name__}): remove A {NAME} by hand at godaddy.com")
                status = 1
            else:
                if not wait_for(False):
                    print(f"   still answered after {WAIT_SECONDS}s")
                    status = 1
            print("5. Compare the zone with the backup")
            try:
                after = client.get_records(domain)
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"   couldn't re-read the zone ({type(e).__name__})")
                status = 1
            else:
                same_bytes = bodies[-1] == bodies[0]
                same_records = sorted(json.dumps(r, sort_keys=True) for r in after) == sorted(
                    json.dumps(r, sort_keys=True) for r in records)
                print(f"   byte for byte the same: {same_bytes} · same records: {same_records} ({len(after)} records)")
                if not same_records:
                    status = 1
    print("Calls: " + ", ".join(f"{m} {s}" for m, _p, s in calls))
    print("RESULT: " + ("GoDaddy accepts our writes; the zone is as it was." if status == 0 else "see above"))
    return status


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main(sys.argv[1:]))

    cd backend && ../.venv/Scripts/python ../scripts/preflight_dns_write.py --yes-owner-approved [--domain launchwitness.com]

Steps (the HTTP status of every GoDaddy call is printed; keys and record values never are):
  1. GET the whole zone and save it (replay/raw/dns_preflight_<time>.json, git-ignored). This is the backup.
  2. PUT  A lw-preflight -> 192.0.2.1 (an address reserved for documentation: it leads nowhere).
  3. Ask every nameserver of the zone until all of them answer 192.0.2.1.
  4. DELETE A lw-preflight, and ask every nameserver until none answers.
  5. GET the zone again and compare it with the backup, byte for byte.
A 401/403 on any call stops the run there (nothing further is tried): then Wednesday uses DNS_MODE=wildcard.
Nothing else in the zone is touched: the client itself refuses anything but an A record for one shop-shaped name.

import sys
import time
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "backend"))

from app.config import get_settings  # noqa: E402

WAIT_SECONDS, POLL = 180, 10

        print("This writes one real DNS record and removes it. Pass --yes-owner-approved to run.")
        return 2

    settings = get_settings().model_copy(update={"godaddy_env": "prod", "app_domain": domain})

        print("GODADDY_API_KEY / GODADDY_API_SECRET are empty in .env: nothing was called.")
        return 2
    client = GoDaddyClient(settings)

    bodies: list[bytes] = []

        return dns.resolve_all(host, "A")

    print(f"1. Backup: read the whole zone of {domain}")
    try:
        records = client.get_records(domain)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"STOPPED at the read ({type(e).__name__}). " + ("GoDaddy refuses this account's API: use DNS_MODE=wildcard."
                                                             if refused(e) else "Nothing was written."))

    backup = ROOT / "replay" / "raw" / f"dns_preflight_{datetime.now(UTC):%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ}.json"

    print("   nameservers before the write:")

    status, written = 0, False
    try:

        try:

        except Exception as e:

                                                                  if refused(e) else "See the status above."))
            return 1
        print("3. Confirm at every nameserver")
        if not wait_for(True):
            print(f"   NOT confirmed within {WAIT_SECONDS}s")
            status = 1
    finally:
        if written:
            print(f"4. Delete: A {NAME}")
            try:
                client.delete_records(domain, "A", NAME)
            except Exception as e:

                status = 1
            else:

                    print(f"   still answered after {WAIT_SECONDS}s")
                    status = 1
            print("5. Compare the zone with the backup")
            try:

                print(f"   couldn't re-read the zone ({type(e).__name__})")
                status = 1
            else:

                print(f"   byte for byte the same: {same_bytes} · same records: {same_records} ({len(after)} records)")
                if not same_records:
                    status = 1
    print("Calls: " + ", ".join(f"{m} {s}" for m, _p, s in calls))
    print("RESULT: " + ("GoDaddy accepts our writes; the zone is as it was." if status == 0 else "see above"))
    return status


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main(sys.argv[1:]))
